 reconstructed=reconstructed[:x]+change['replacement'].encode()+reconstructed[y:]
archive_name='docs/task-history/M3/M3.6.9.6.3.2.2.15.2.1.4.3.2.1.md'
a,b=span(old_task,payload['archive_from_prior_task_identity'])
archive=old_task[a:b]
assert archive.endswith(b'\n\n')

row=payload['history_index_row'].encode()
offset=payload['history_index_insertion_byte_offset']
assert isinstance(offset,int) and 0<=offset<=len(old_index)
index=old_index[:offset]+row+old_index[offset:]
rust_name='xtask/src/trust.rs'

anchor=payload['rust_insertion_anchor'].encode()
body=payload['parent_source'].encode()
assert old_rust.count(anchor)==1

overrides={rust_name:rust,'docs/tasks/M3.md':reconstructed,index_name:index,archive_name:archive}
metadata={}
for raw in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','-z',base]).split(b'\0'):
 if not raw:continue
 head,name=raw.split(b'\t',1);mode,kind,oid=head.decode().split(' ')
 metadata[name.decode()]=(mode,kind,oid)
for filename,entry in inputs['regular'].items():
 data=overrides[filename] if filename in overrides else prior(filename)
 assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==entry['sha256'],filename
 assert obj('blob',data)==entry['index_oid'],filename
 if filename in metadata:assert metadata[filename][0]==entry['index_mode'],filename
 else:assert filename==archive_name and entry['index_mode']=='100644'
for filename,oid in inputs['gitlinks'].items():assert metadata[filename]==('160000','commit',oid)
oids={name:obj('blob',data) for name,data in overrides.items()}
def tree_hash(path,update):
 spec=base+(':'+path if path else '')
 rows={}
 for raw in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-z',spec]).split(b'\0'):
  if not raw:continue
  head,name=raw.split(b'\t',1);mode,kind,oid=head.split(b' ')
  rows[name]=(mode.lstrip(b'0'),kind,oid.decode())
 for filename,oid in update.items():
  parent=filename.rsplit('/',1)[0] if '/' in filename else ''
  if parent==path:
   name=filename.rsplit('/',1)[-1].encode()
   rows[name]=(b'100644',b'blob',oid)
 payload=[]
 for name,(mode,kind,oid) in sorted(rows.items(),key=lambda item:item[0]+(b'/' if item[1][1]==b'tree' else b'')):
  relative=(path+'/' if path else '')+name.decode()
  if kind==b'tree' and any(filename.startswith(relative+'/') for filename in update):
   oid=tree_hash(relative,update)
  payload.append(mode+b' '+name+b'\0'+bytes.fromhex(oid))
 return obj('tree',b''.join(payload))
assert tree_hash('',{})==subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',base+'^{tree}'],text=True).strip()
assert tree_hash('',oids)==execution['held_tree']

Thus both predicates choose the same first pair or the same empty default; the unchanged fifteen-byte slice starts after the same complete ASCII prefix at a valid UTF-8 boundary and returns identical bytes, preserving dep-info selection and subsequent behavior. Permanent exact production/controller/observer/base/configuration/metadata/parser/tree/module/dependency/pin guards outside semantic tests, actual compiled original/edit, complete real ordinary/incremental/mixed argv and three consumed libraries, literal/constructor/adjacency controls, wider changed-output and short/Unicode panic witnesses, nineteen altered-premise controls and three wrong-oracle controls delimit the proof. Wider argv is explicitly not equivalent; finite producer agreement is not the proof. This conditional lemma covers actual successful invocations by that pinned producer; other judged-tree toolchain producers are outside it. #### Final replay and audit adapters

Run from the repository root with the local stores from `TOOLBOX.md`. The execution adapters describe the captured pre-publication state. Extract the JSON evidence and the following adapter bodies into the named ignored output directory, deriving `bindings.json` from the plan’s `source_bindings` and `parent-names.json` from `semantic_parent_names`. The held manifest and portable delta reproduce the captured source inputs from the retained commit. Native commands and compilation commands create new measurements; historical outcomes are retained receipts. The reconstruction adapter uses only published committed inputs and the captured immutable delta after publication. A fresh measurement must snapshot its own current inputs in a new owned run and retain separate evidence; do not present that new run as the historical receipt. The final publication audit validates the retained evidence and exact publication bytes.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,re,subprocess
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
root=Path.cwd();out=root/"target/cache-final-checkpoint"
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("adequacy",root/"scripts/trust_adequacy.py");m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
plan=json.loads((out/"plan.json").read_text());bindings=json.loads((out/"bindings.json").read_text())
for filename,sha in bindings.items():assert hashlib.sha256((root/filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha,filename
assert hashlib.sha256((root/plan["file"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==plan["source_sha256"]
profile=out/"mutation-volume.sb";assert hashlib.sha256(profile.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="2b3fbe199bddb4ba84c453a23334c7025308b06127ce3cc96f74b2a17680eedd"
held=subprocess.check_output(["git","write-tree"],text=True).strip()
command=plan["native_command"]
assert isinstance(command,list) and all(isinstance(v,str) for v in command)
(out/"execution.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=command,held_tree=held,source_sha256=plan["source_sha256"],profile="target/cache-final-checkpoint/mutation-volume.sb",writable_root=".",scope="Complete frozen cache/current-reason final replay; source-bound justified outcomes only, global review remains separate"),indent=2)+"\n")
error=None
try:
 with (out/"native.log").open("w") as log:
  result=subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/sandbox-exec","-D","WRITABLE_ROOT="+str(root),"-f",str(profile),*command],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1"))
 (out/"native.exit").write_text(str(result.returncode)+"\n")
 measured=m.audit_measurement((out/"native.log").read_text(),plan,plan["file"],result.returncode)
 names=set(json.loads((out/"parent-names.json").read_text()))
 for row in measured["entries"]:
  if row["outcome"]=="killed":assert row["names"] and set(row["names"])<=names,row
 (out/"measurement.json").write_text(json.dumps(measured,indent=2)+"\n")
 assert not any(measured["counts"].get(key) for key in ("survived","timeout","unjudged")),measured["counts"]
 assert measured["raw_exit_code"]==0,measured
except Exception as caught:
 error=caught
 (out/"measurement-refusal.json").write_text(json.dumps({"status":"refused","error":str(caught)})+"\n")
finally:
 subprocess.run(["python3","-I","-B","scripts/trust_adequacy.py","--check-inputs","target/cache-final-checkpoint/native-inputs.json","--output","target/cache-final-checkpoint/original-restoration.json"],check=True)
 expected=json.loads((out/"native-inputs.json").read_text())
 copy_root=root/"target/mutation-sweep/tree"
 items=[(name,{"index_mode":row["index_mode"],"index_oid":row["index_oid"]}) for name,row in expected["regular"].items()]
 with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
  actual=dict(pool.map(lambda item:m.regular_input(copy_root,item),items))
 assert actual==expected["regular"]
 (out/"copy-restoration.json").write_text(json.dumps({"status":"restored","qualification":"Maintained regular_input; borrowed index metadata, no copied Git index or submodule-content claim.","regular":actual},indent=2)+"\n")
 print(len(actual),"current copied inputs restored")
listing=subprocess.run(["cargo","test","-q","-p","xtask","--","--list","trust::","trust_generated::","trust_gate::","--skip","route_tests"],cwd=root/"target/mutation-sweep/tree",env=dict(os.environ,CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(root/"target/mutation-sweep/target"),ARCHOGEN_SWEEP_SOURCE=str(root)),capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
(out/"copied-parent-list.log").write_text(listing.stdout+listing.stderr)
assert re.findall(r"^([\w:]+): test$",listing.stdout,re.M)==json.loads((out/"parent-names.json").read_text())
for filename,sha in bindings.items():assert hashlib.sha256((root/filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha,filename
if error:raise error
print("complete final cache/current-reason native replay",json.dumps(measured["counts"]),"all original/copy inputs and parents restore; held",held)

```python
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/"target/cache-final-checkpoint/component-qualification"
tree=out/"tree"
manifest=json.loads((root/"target/cache-final-checkpoint/native-inputs.json").read_text())
def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
assert not tree.exists()
tree.mkdir(parents=True)
for filename,entry in manifest["regular"].items():
 src=root/filename;dest=tree/filename
 data=src.read_bytes()
 assert sha(data)==entry["sha256"],filename
 dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 dest.write_bytes(data)
 dest.chmod(src.stat().st_mode & 0o777)
env=dict(os.environ,CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(out/"target"),ARCHOGEN_SWEEP_SOURCE=str(root))
command=["cargo","test","-q","--offline","-p","xtask","--no-run"]
with (out/"baseline.log").open("w") as log:
 result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=tree,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
(out/"baseline.exit").write_text(str(result.returncode)+"\n")
receipt={"status":"passed" if result.returncode==0 else "refused","scope":"Actual whole xtask component and test compilation, no semantic mutation outcome inferred","command":command,"tree":"target/cache-final-checkpoint/component-qualification/tree","target":"target/cache-final-checkpoint/component-qualification/target","regular_inputs":len(manifest["regular"]),"gitlinks":"metadata only, no submodule content copied","source_sha256":sha((tree/"xtask/src/trust.rs").read_bytes()),"exit":result.returncode}
(out/"baseline.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+"\n")
assert result.returncode==0,receipt
print(json.dumps(receipt))

```python
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'target/cache-final-checkpoint/component-qualification'
tree=out/'tree';file=tree/'xtask/src/trust.rs'
plan=json.loads((root/'target/cache-final-checkpoint/plan.json').read_text())
original=(root/'target/cache-final-checkpoint/source-native.rs.txt').read_bytes()
def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
assert file.read_bytes()==original and sha(original)==plan['source_sha256']
baseline=json.loads((out/'baseline.json').read_text())
assert baseline['exit']==0 and baseline['source_sha256']==sha(original)
env=dict(os.environ,CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(out/'target'),ARCHOGEN_SWEEP_SOURCE=str(root))
command=['cargo','test','-q','--offline','-p','xtask','--no-run','--message-format=json']
rows=[]
try:
 for identity in ['L1309.contains.1122','L1309.contains.1124']:
  c=next(c for c in plan['candidates'] if c['id']==identity)
  lines=original.decode().split('\n');start,stop=c['span']
  assert '\n'.join(lines[start:stop])==c['original']
  lines[start:stop]=c['replacement'].split('\n')
  mutated='\n'.join(lines).encode()
  assert mutated!=original
  file.write_bytes(mutated);assert file.read_bytes()==mutated
  run=subprocess.run(command,cwd=tree,env=env,capture_output=True)
  (out/(identity+'.stdout.jsonl')).write_bytes(run.stdout)
  (out/(identity+'.stderr.log')).write_bytes(run.stderr)
  errors=[]
  for line in run.stdout.splitlines():
   message=json.loads(line)
   if message.get('reason')!='compiler-message':continue
   body=message['message']
   if body.get('level')=='error':
    errors.append(dict(code=(body.get('code') or {}).get('code'),message=body['message'],primary_spans=[s for s in body.get('spans',[]) if s.get('is_primary')]))
  rows.append(dict(id=identity,span=c['span'],original=c['original'],replacement=c['replacement'],source_sha256=sha(mutated),exit=run.returncode,errors=errors))
  assert run.returncode!=0 and errors,identity
finally:
 file.write_bytes(original);assert file.read_bytes()==original
recovery=subprocess.run(command,cwd=tree,env=env,capture_output=True)
(out/'recovery.stdout.jsonl').write_bytes(recovery.stdout);(out/'recovery.stderr.log').write_bytes(recovery.stderr)
assert recovery.returncode==0
manifest=json.loads((root/'target/cache-final-checkpoint/native-inputs.json').read_text())
for filename,entry in manifest['regular'].items():assert sha((tree/filename).read_bytes())==entry['sha256'],filename
receipt=dict(status='actual-component-compilations-observed',scope='Independent component compilation only; native outcomes not inferred',baseline_exit=baseline['exit'],command=command,source_sha256=sha(original),mutants=rows,recovery_exit=recovery.returncode,all_regular_inputs_restored=len(manifest['regular']))
(out/'copied-observations.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt))

```python
from pathlib import Path
import copy,hashlib,importlib.util,json
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
out=Path('target/cache-final-checkpoint');component=out/'component-qualification'
plan=json.loads((out/'plan.json').read_text());observations=json.loads((component/'copied-observations.json').read_text())
def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
source=(out/'source-native.rs.txt').read_text()
def qualify(identity,stream,exit_code):
 assert exit_code==101
 c=next(c for c in plan['candidates'] if c['id']==identity)
 errors=[]
 for line in stream.splitlines():
  message=json.loads(line)
  if message.get('reason')=='compiler-message' and message['message'].get('level')=='error':
   errors.append(message['message'])
 assert len(errors)==2 and {row['code']['code'] for row in errors}=={'E0277','E0308'}
 for error in errors:
  spans=[span for span in error['spans'] if span['is_primary']]
  assert len(spans)==1
  span=spans[0]
  assert span['file_name']==plan['file'] and span['line_start']==span['line_end']==c['span'][0]+1
  assert len(span['text'])==1 and span['text'][0]['text']==c['replacement']
  if error['code']['code']=='E0277':
   assert error['message']=='the trait bound `String: Copy` is not satisfied'
   assert span['label']=='the trait `Copy` is not implemented for `String`'
  else:
   assert error['message']=='mismatched types' and span['label']=='expected `String`, found `&String`'
 return errors
negative=[];rows=[]
for observation in observations['mutants']:
 identity=observation['id'];stdout=(component/(identity+'.stdout.jsonl')).read_text()
 errors=qualify(identity,stdout,observation['exit'])
 c=next(c for c in plan['candidates'] if c['id']==identity)
 lines=source.split('\n');lines[c['span'][0]:c['span'][1]]=c['replacement'].split('\n')
 assert sha('\n'.join(lines).encode())==observation['source_sha256']
 assert [dict(code=e['code']['code'],message=e['message'],primary_spans=[s for s in e['spans'] if s['is_primary']]) for e in errors]==observation['errors']
 messages=[json.loads(line) for line in stdout.splitlines()]
 index=next(i for i,m in enumerate(messages) if m.get('reason')=='compiler-message' and m['message'].get('level')=='error')
 for label,alter in [
  ('wrong-error-code',lambda ms:ms[index]['message']['code'].__setitem__('code','E9999')),
  ('wrong-file',lambda ms:next(s for s in ms[index]['message']['spans'] if s['is_primary']).__setitem__('file_name','foreign.rs')),
  ('wrong-line',lambda ms:next(s for s in ms[index]['message']['spans'] if s['is_primary']).__setitem__('line_start',1)),
  ('wrong-replacement',lambda ms:next(s for s in ms[index]['message']['spans'] if s['is_primary'])['text'][0].__setitem__('text','unrelated source')),
 ]:
  bad=copy.deepcopy(messages);alter(bad)

out=Path('target/cache-final-checkpoint')
base='d837d7124539202a502662c7bc1a18533da6f620'
B=chr(96)
def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def prior(name):return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+name])
def obj(kind,data):return hashlib.sha1(kind.encode()+b' '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\0'+data).hexdigest()
def span(data,identity):
 a=data.index(('- ID: '+B+identity+B).encode())
 tail=data[a+1:]
 ends=[a+1+m.start() for m in re.finditer(rb'(?m)^- ID: |^## ',tail)]
 return a,min(ends) if ends else len(data)

execution=json.loads((out/'execution.json').read_text())

  assert old[:a]+replacement+old[b:]==current,name

 (out/'input-reconstruction-delta.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n')

payload=json.loads((out/'input-reconstruction-delta.json').read_text())
assert payload['base_commit']==base and payload['archive_file']==archive_name
overrides={}
for change in payload['task_replacements']:
 old=prior(change['file']);a,b=span(old,change['identity'])
 assert sha(old[a:b])==change['before_sha256']
 overrides[change['file']]=old[:a]+change['replacement'].encode()+old[b:]

metadata={}
for raw in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','-z',base]).split(b'\0'):
 if not raw:continue
 head,name=raw.split(b'\t',1);mode,kind,oid=head.decode().split(' ')
 metadata[name.decode()]=(mode,kind,oid)
assert set(inputs['regular'])=={name for name,(mode,kind,oid) in metadata.items() if kind=='blob'}|{archive_name}
assert set(inputs['gitlinks'])=={name for name,(mode,kind,oid) in metadata.items() if kind=='commit'}
for filename,entry in inputs['regular'].items():
 data=overrides[filename] if filename in overrides else prior(filename)
 assert sha(data)==entry['sha256'],filename

for filename,oid in inputs['gitlinks'].items():assert metadata[filename]==('160000','commit',oid)

def tree_hash(path,update):
 spec=base+(':'+path if path else '')
 rows={}
 for raw in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-z',spec]).split(b'\0'):
  if not raw:continue
  head,name=raw.split(b'\t',1);mode,kind,oid=head.split(b' ')
  rows[name]=(mode.lstrip(b'0'),kind,oid.decode())
 for filename,oid in update.items():
  parent=filename.rsplit('/',1)[0] if '/' in filename else ''
  if parent==path:rows[filename.rsplit('/',1)[-1].encode()]=(b'100644',b'blob',oid)
 body=[]
 for name,(mode,kind,oid) in sorted(rows.items(),key=lambda item:item[0]+(b'/' if item[1][1]==b'tree' else b'')):
  relative=(path+'/' if path else '')+name.decode()
  if kind==b'tree' and any(filename.startswith(relative+'/') for filename in update):oid=tree_hash(relative,update)
  body.append(mode+b' '+name+b'\0'+bytes.fromhex(oid))
 return obj('tree',b''.join(body))

#### Current suffix execution and audit adapters

Run from the repository root with the local stores from `TOOLBOX.md`. The execution adapters describe the captured pre-publication state. Extract the JSON evidence and the following adapter bodies into the named ignored output directory, deriving `bindings.json` from the plan’s `source_bindings` and `parent-names.json` from `semantic_parent_names`. The held manifest and portable delta reproduce the captured source inputs from the retained commit. Native commands and compilation commands create new measurements; historical outcomes are retained receipts. The reconstruction adapter uses only published committed inputs and the captured immutable delta after publication. A fresh measurement must snapshot its own current inputs in a new owned run and retain separate evidence; do not present that new run as the historical receipt. The final publication audit validates the retained evidence and exact publication bytes.

from pathlib import Path

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
root=Path.cwd();out=root/"target/suffix-final-checkpoint"
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("adequacy",root/"scripts/trust_adequacy.py");m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
plan=json.loads((out/"plan.json").read_text());bindings=json.loads((out/"bindings.json").read_text())
proof=json.loads((out/"proof.json").read_text());assert proof["status"]=="passed" and proof["source_sha256"]==plan["source_sha256"]
for filename,sha in bindings.items():assert hashlib.sha256((root/filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha,filename
assert hashlib.sha256((root/plan["file"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==plan["source_sha256"]
profile=out/"mutation-volume.sb";assert hashlib.sha256(profile.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="2b3fbe199bddb4ba84c453a23334c7025308b06127ce3cc96f74b2a17680eedd"
held=subprocess.check_output(["git","write-tree"],text=True).strip()
command=plan["native_command"]
assert isinstance(command,list) and all(isinstance(v,str) for v in command)
(out/"execution.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=command,held_tree=held,source_sha256=plan["source_sha256"],profile="target/suffix-final-checkpoint/mutation-volume.sb",writable_root=".",scope="Exactly both mapped current caller suffix edits; source-bound justified outcomes only; full caller/global/review remain separate"),indent=2)+"\n")
error=None
try:
 with (out/"native.log").open("w") as log:
  result=subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/sandbox-exec","-D","WRITABLE_ROOT="+str(root),"-f",str(profile),*command],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1"))
 (out/"native.exit").write_text(str(result.returncode)+"\n")
 measured=m.audit_measurement((out/"native.log").read_text(),plan,plan["file"],result.returncode)
 names=set(json.loads((out/"parent-names.json").read_text()))
 for row in measured["entries"]:
  if row["outcome"]=="killed":assert row["names"] and set(row["names"])<=names,row
 rows={row["id"]:row for row in measured["entries"]}
 assert rows["L729.dir.201"]["outcome"]=="killed" and plan["intended_killing_parent"] in rows["L729.dir.201"]["names"]
 assert rows["L729.lit.202"]["outcome"]=="equivalent" and rows["L729.lit.202"]["reason"]==plan["equivalents"][0]["reason"]
 (out/"measurement.json").write_text(json.dumps(measured,indent=2)+"\n")
 assert not any(measured["counts"].get(key) for key in ("survived","timeout","unjudged")),measured["counts"]
 assert measured["raw_exit_code"]==0,measured
except Exception as caught:
 error=caught
 (out/"measurement-refusal.json").write_text(json.dumps({"status":"refused","error":str(caught)})+"\n")
finally:
 subprocess.run(["python3","-I","-B","scripts/trust_adequacy.py","--check-inputs","target/suffix-final-checkpoint/native-inputs.json","--output","target/suffix-final-checkpoint/original-restoration.json"],check=True)
 expected=json.loads((out/"native-inputs.json").read_text())
 copy_root=root/"target/mutation-sweep/tree"
 items=[(name,{"index_mode":row["index_mode"],"index_oid":row["index_oid"]}) for name,row in expected["regular"].items()]
 with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
  actual=dict(pool.map(lambda item:m.regular_input(copy_root,item),items))
 assert actual==expected["regular"]
 (out/"copy-restoration.json").write_text(json.dumps({"status":"restored","qualification":"Maintained regular_input; borrowed index metadata, no copied Git index or submodule-content claim.","regular":actual},indent=2)+"\n")
 print(len(actual),"current copied inputs restored")
listing=subprocess.run(["cargo","test","-q","-p","xtask","--","--list","trust::","trust_generated::","trust_gate::","--skip","route_tests"],cwd=root/"target/mutation-sweep/tree",env=dict(os.environ,CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(root/"target/mutation-sweep/target"),ARCHOGEN_SWEEP_SOURCE=str(root)),capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
(out/"copied-parent-list.log").write_text(listing.stdout+listing.stderr)
assert re.findall(r"^([\w:]+): test$",listing.stdout,re.M)==json.loads((out/"parent-names.json").read_text())
for filename,sha in bindings.items():assert hashlib.sha256((root/filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha,filename
if error:raise error
print("complete current caller suffix native replay",json.dumps(measured["counts"]),"all original/copy inputs and parents restore; held",held)

def tree_hash(path,update):
 spec=base+(':'+path if path else '')
 rows={}
 for raw in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-z',spec]).split(b'\0'):
  if not raw:continue
  head,name=raw.split(b'\t',1);mode,kind,oid=head.split(b' ')
  rows[name]=(mode.lstrip(b'0'),kind,oid.decode())
 for filename,oid in update.items():
  parent=filename.rsplit('/',1)[0] if '/' in filename else ''
  if parent==path:rows[filename.rsplit('/',1)[-1].encode()]=(b'100644',b'blob',oid)
 body=[]
 for name,(mode,kind,oid) in sorted(rows.items(),key=lambda item:item[0]+(b'/' if item[1][1]==b'tree' else b'')):
  relative=(path+'/' if path else '')+name.decode()
  if kind==b'tree' and any(filename.startswith(relative+'/') for filename in update):oid=tree_hash(relative,update)
  body.append(mode+b' '+name+b'\0'+bytes.fromhex(oid))
 return obj('tree',b''.join(body))

from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import json,re
out=Path("target/suffix-final-checkpoint")
plan=json.loads((out/"plan.json").read_text())
expected={c["id"] for c in plan["candidates"]}
equivalents={(r["original"].strip(),r["replacement"].strip()) for r in plan["equivalents"]}
reasons={c["id"] for c in plan["candidates"] if (c["original"].strip(),c["replacement"].strip()) in equivalents}
p=out/"native.log"
raw=p.read_text() if p.exists() else ""
complete=raw[:raw.rfind("\n")+1]
rows=[m.groups() for m in re.finditer(r"^  ([✓✗·?=]) (\S+) +(\w+) +",complete,re.M)]
seen=[row[1] for row in rows]
alerts=[]
if len(set(seen))!=len(seen):alerts.append("duplicate result")
if set(seen)-expected:alerts.append("foreign identity")
for mark,identity,outcome in rows:
 if outcome=="unjudged":alerts.append(identity+": unjudged")
 if identity in reasons and outcome!="equivalent":alerts.append(identity+": current reason contradicted by "+outcome)
active=[]
source=(out/"source-native.rs.txt").read_text()
copy=Path("target/mutation-sweep/tree")/plan["file"]
if copy.exists():
 observed=copy.read_text()
 if observed==source:active=["original/between edits"]
 else:
  for c in plan["candidates"]:
   lines=source.split("\n");start,stop=c["span"]
   lines[start:stop]=c["replacement"].split("\n")
   if "\n".join(lines)==observed:active.append(c["id"])
  if not active:active=["unmatched source observation; recheck before inferring drift"]

print(json.dumps({"active_copy":active,"completed":len(rows),"planned":len(expected),"counts":dict(Counter(row[2] for row in rows)),"recent":rows[-3:],"alerts":alerts,"baseline_reported":"mutation-sweep: the unmutated copy passes" in complete,"log_bytes":p.stat().st_size if p.exists() else 0,"terminal":(out/"native.exit").read_text().strip() if (out/"native.exit").exists() else None},ensure_ascii=False))

            'Cargo.lock': '5164fe99ab7234dc8346121de7ee3f8b16599c31d585433c93809104676a6f64',
            'rust-toolchain.toml': '4706b7b407427c38a3b63860b2e131cacc9eb57569a6755a39e81756cca676cd',
            '.cargo/config.toml': '48296b18a2b27cc7268cf489fc37bdcf24e04d79b914c2237c248e4db1f6fa79',
        }
        version = self.bounded(["cargo", "--version", "--verbose"])
        commit = "commit-hash: f2d3ce0bd7f24a49f8f72d9000448f8838c4e850"

        def premises(values, producer):
            actual = {path: hashlib.sha256(data.split(b"#[cfg(test)]", 1)[0]
                       if path in production_prefixes else data).hexdigest()
                      for path, data in values.items()}
            self.assertEqual(actual, expected, "caller suffix source premise requires revalidation")
            self.assertIn(commit, producer, "caller suffix producer premise requires revalidation")

        premises(inputs, version)
        for path in paths:
            altered = dict(inputs)
            altered[path] = b"// changed premise\n" + altered[path]
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError, "source premise requires revalidation"):
                premises(altered, version)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError, "producer premise requires revalidation"):
            premises(inputs, version.replace(commit, "commit-hash: changed", 1))

        source = inputs["xtask/src/trust.rs"].decode()
        namespace, literals = self.discovery(source, "lit")
        key = ('(w[0] == "-C" && w[1].starts_with("extra-filename="))',
               '(w[0] == "-C" && w[1].starts_with("extra-filename"))')
        family = [candidate for candidate in literals if namespace["mutation_key"](candidate) == key]
        self.assertEqual(len(family), 1, "one exact actual caller edit")

        def module(text, name):
            start = text.index("        let extra = tokens\n")
            end = text.index("        // The unit's package", start)
            body = text[start:end]
            self.assertEqual(body.count(".windows(2)"), 1)
            return f"mod {name} {{ pub fn collect(tokens: &[String]) -> String {{\n{body}extra\n}} }}\n"

        modules = module(source, "baseline") + module(namespace["apply_mutant"](family[0]), "variant")
        ordinary = self.producer_argv("caller-suffix-ordinary", library_source="pub fn c() -> u32 { 37 }\n")
        incremental = self.producer_argv("caller-suffix-incremental",
                                       library_source="pub fn c() -> u32 { 37 }\n",
                                       release_incremental=True)

        # This distinct, real producer exercises Cargo's optional no-suffix branch.
        project = self.base / "producer-caller-extra-filename=inside"
        (project / "src").mkdir(parents=True)
        (project / "Cargo.toml").write_text(
            '[workspace]\n[package]\nname = "flagproof"\nversion = "0.1.0"\nedition = "2021"\n'
            '[lib]\ncrate-type = ["rlib", "dylib"]\n[profile.release]\nincremental = true\n')
        (project / "src/lib.rs").write_text("pub fn c() -> u32 { 37 }\n")
        target = project / "target"
        env = {name: os.environ[name] for name in ("PATH", "HOME")}
        env.update(RUSTUP_HOME=os.environ.get("RUSTUP_HOME", str(Path(env["HOME"]) / ".rustup")),
                   RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN="1.95.0", RUSTC="rustc", CARGO_HOME=str(project / "cargo-home"),
                   CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(target), TMPDIR=str(self.base), TMP=str(self.base), TEMP=str(self.base))

        def cargo(arguments):
            process = subprocess.Popen(["cargo"] + arguments, cwd=project, env=env,
                                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                                       text=True, start_new_session=True)
            try:
                stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=60)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                process.communicate()
                self.fail("actual optional-suffix Cargo producer timed out")
            self.assertEqual(process.returncode, 0, stdout + stderr)
            return stderr

        cargo(["generate-lockfile", "--offline"])
        stderr = cargo(["build", "--lib", "--release", "--locked", "--offline", "--no-default-features",
                        "--message-format=json", "-v", "-p", "flagproof"])
        commands = [line.strip()[len("Running `"):-1] for line in stderr.splitlines()
                    if line.strip().startswith("Running `rustc ") and line.strip().endswith("`")]
        self.assertEqual(len(commands), 1, stderr)
        mixed = shlex.split(commands[0])
        metadata = [arg for arg in mixed if re.fullmatch(r"metadata=[0-9a-f]{16}", arg)]
        self.assertEqual(len(metadata), 1)
        expected_mixed = ["rustc", "--crate-name", "flagproof", "--edition=2021", "src/lib.rs",
                          "--error-format=json", "--json=diagnostic-rendered-ansi,artifacts,future-incompat",
                          "--crate-type", "rlib", "--crate-type", "dylib", "--emit=dep-info,link",
                          "-C", "opt-level=3", "-C", "embed-bitcode=no", "--check-cfg", "cfg(docsrs,test)", "--check-cfg",
                          "cfg(feature, values())", "-C", metadata[0], "--out-dir", str(target / "release/deps"),
                          "-C", "incremental=" + str(target / "release/incremental"),
                          "-C", "strip=debuginfo", "-L", "dependency=" + str(target / "release/deps")]
        self.assertEqual(mixed, expected_mixed, "independent complete optional-suffix producer argv")
        self.assertEqual(sorted(path.name for path in (target / "release/deps").glob("*.d")), ["flagproof.d"])
        self.assertIn("src/lib.rs", (target / "release/deps/flagproof.d").read_text())

        actual = []
        for label, argv, base in [("ordinary", ordinary, self.base / "producer-caller-suffix-ordinary"),
                                 ("incremental", incremental, self.base / "producer-caller-suffix-incremental"),
                                 ("mixed", mixed, project)]:
            operands = [value for left, value in zip(argv, argv[1:]) if left == "-C"
                        and re.fullmatch(r"extra-filename=-[0-9a-f]{16}", value)]
            self.assertEqual(len(operands), 0 if label == "mixed" else 1)
            suffix = operands[0].split("=", 1)[1] if operands else ""
            library = base / "target/release/deps" / ("libflagproof" + suffix + ".rlib")
            self.assertTrue(library.read_bytes().startswith(b"!<arch>\n"))
            consumer, binary = base / "consumer.rs", base / "consumer"
            consumer.write_text('fn main() { println!("{}", flagproof::c()); }\n')
            self.bounded(["rustc", "--edition=2021", "--crate-name", "caller_suffix_consumer", str(consumer),
                          "--extern", "flagproof=" + str(library), "-o", str(binary)])
            self.assertEqual(self.bounded([str(binary)]), "37\n")
            actual.append((label, argv, suffix))

        vector = lambda values: ("vec![" + ", ".join(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False) + ".to_owned()"
                                                    for value in values) + "]"
                                 if values else "Vec::<String>::new()")
        checks = []
        for label, argv, suffix in actual:
            for name in ["baseline", "variant"]:
                checks.append(f'assert_eq!({name}::collect(&{vector(argv)}), {json.dumps(suffix)}, "{label}");')
        literal = [([], ""), (["-C"], ""), (["rustc", "extra-filenameX=tail"], ""),
                   (["-C", "extra-filename="], ""),
                   (["-C", "extra-filename=-0123456789abcdef"], "-0123456789abcdef"),
                   (["-C", "extra-filename=-é"], "-é"),
                   (["-C", "extra-filename=-first", "-C", "extra-filename=-second"], "-first"),
                   (["-C", "incremental=cache/extra-filenameX=tail"], ""),
                   (["-C", "metadata=extra-filenameX=tail"], ""),
                   (["--out-dir", "-C", "--error-format=json"], "")]
        # These are constructor/adjacency controls, not additional successful Cargo inputs.
        for operand in ["prefer-dynamic", "rpath", "lto", "linker-plugin-lto"] + [
                name + "=extra-filenameX=tail" for name in [
                    "opt-level", "panic", "lto", "embed-bitcode", "codegen-units", "debuginfo",
                    "split-debuginfo", "debug-assertions", "overflow-checks", "metadata", "linker",
                    "incremental", "strip", "link-arg"]]:
            literal.append((["-C", operand], ""))
        literal.append((["--check-cfg", "-C", "-C", "extra-filename=-held"], "-held"))
        for argv, suffix in literal:
            for name in ["baseline", "variant"]:
                checks.append(f'assert_eq!({name}::collect(&{vector(argv)}), '
                              f'{json.dumps(suffix, ensure_ascii=False)}, "literal suffix");')
        wider = ["-C", "extra-filenameX=tail"]
        incidental = ["--out-dir", "-C", "extra-filenameX=tail"]
        for argv in [wider, incidental]:
            checks += [f'assert_eq!(baseline::collect(&{vector(argv)}), "");',
                       f'assert_eq!(variant::collect(&{vector(argv)}), "=tail");']
        for value in ["extra-filename", "extra-filenameé=tail"]:
            argv = vector(["-C", value])
            checks += [f'assert_eq!(baseline::collect(&{argv}), "");',
                       f'assert!(std::panic::catch_unwind(|| variant::collect(&{argv})).is_err());']
        main = ("fn main() {\n" + "\n".join(checks)
                + '\nmatch std::env::args().nth(1).as_deref() {\n'
                + f' Some("wrong-positive") => assert_eq!(baseline::collect(&{vector(wider)}), '
                + f'variant::collect(&{vector(wider)}), "wrong wider equality"),\n'
                + f' Some("wrong-negative") => assert_ne!(baseline::collect(&{vector(ordinary)}), '
                + f'variant::collect(&{vector(ordinary)}), "wrong supported inequality"),\n'
                + ' Some("wrong-literal") => assert_eq!(baseline::collect(&vec!["-C".into(), '
                + '"extra-filename=-held".into()]), "-changed", "wrong literal suffix"),\n'
                + ' _ => {}\n}\nprintln!("caller suffix controls: literal, actual, wider and panic domains held");\n}\n')
        program, binary = self.base / "caller-suffix.rs", self.base / "caller-suffix"
        program.write_text(modules + main)
        self.bounded(["rustc", "--edition=2021", str(program), "-o", str(binary)])
        self.assertIn("literal, actual, wider and panic domains held", self.bounded([str(binary)]))
        for argument, message in [("wrong-positive", "wrong wider equality"),
                                  ("wrong-negative", "wrong supported inequality"),
                                  ("wrong-literal", "wrong literal suffix")]:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError, message):
                self.bounded([str(binary), argument])
        print("caller suffix compiled controls complete; checking the precise reason", flush=True)
        records = namespace["load_equivalents"](ROOT / "xtask/trust.equivalents")
        self.assertTrue(key in records, "the completed caller proof requires its exact per-file reason")

#### Environment-tail assessment execution and audit adapters

Run from the repository root with the local stores from `TOOLBOX.md`. The execution adapters describe the captured pre-publication state. Extract the JSON evidence and the following adapter bodies into the named ignored output directory, deriving `bindings.json` from the plan’s `source_bindings` and `parent-names.json` from `semantic_parent_names`. The held manifest and portable delta reproduce the captured source inputs from the retained commit. Native commands and compilation commands create new measurements; historical outcomes are retained receipts. The reconstruction adapter uses only published committed inputs and the captured immutable delta after publication. A fresh measurement must snapshot its own current inputs in a new owned run and retain separate evidence; do not present that new run as the historical receipt. The final publication audit validates the retained evidence and exact publication bytes.

<details>
<summary>Final checkpoint adapter: prepare.py</summary>

 tail=data[a+1:]

 return a,min(ends) if ends else len(data)

 insertion=current[a:b];anchor=('- ID: '+B+next_sibling+B).encode()
 assert reconstructed.count(anchor)==1
 reconstructed=reconstructed.replace(anchor,insertion+anchor,1)
 assert reconstructed==current
 old_index=prior(index_name);index=Path(index_name).read_bytes()
 row=next(line for line in index.splitlines(keepends=True) if line.startswith(('| '+B+identities[0]+B+' |').encode()))
 assert index.replace(row,b'',1)==old_index
 payload=dict(base_commit=base,task_replacements=changes,task_insertion=insertion.decode(),task_insertion_anchor=anchor.decode(),history_index_row=row.decode(),history_index_insertion_byte_offset=index.index(row),archive_file=archive_name,archive_source_file=task_name,archive_identities=identities[:1])
 (out/'input-reconstruction-delta.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n')

payload=json.loads((out/'input-reconstruction-delta.json').read_text())
assert payload['base_commit']==base and payload['archive_file']==archive_name
overrides={}
for change in payload['task_replacements']:

 assert sha(old[a:b])==change['before_sha256']
 overrides[change['file']]=old[:a]+change['replacement'].encode()+old[b:]
anchor=payload['task_insertion_anchor'].encode()
assert overrides[task_name].count(anchor)==1
without_children=overrides[task_name]
overrides[task_name]=without_children.replace(anchor,payload['task_insertion'].encode()+anchor,1)
old=prior(payload['archive_source_file']);blocks=[]
for identity in payload['archive_identities']:
 a,b=span(old,identity);assert old[a:b].endswith(b'\n')
 blocks.append(old[a:b-1])
archive=b'\n'.join(blocks)
if not archive.endswith(b'\n'):archive+=b'\n'
assert sha(archive)==inputs['regular'][archive_name]['sha256']
overrides[archive_name]=archive

overrides[index_name]=old_index[:offset]+payload['history_index_row'].encode()+old_index[offset:]
metadata={}
for raw in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','-z',base]).split(b'\0'):
 if not raw:continue
 head,name=raw.split(b'\t',1);mode,kind,oid=head.decode().split(' ')
 metadata[name.decode()]=(mode,kind,oid)
assert set(inputs['regular'])=={name for name,(mode,kind,oid) in metadata.items() if kind=='blob'}|{archive_name}
assert set(inputs['gitlinks'])=={name for name,(mode,kind,oid) in metadata.items() if kind=='commit'}
for filename,entry in inputs['regular'].items():

for filename,oid in inputs['gitlinks'].items():assert metadata[filename]==('160000','commit',oid)

def tree_hash(path,update):

 rows={}
 for raw in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-z',spec]).split(b'\0'):

  if kind==b'tree' and any(filename.startswith(relative+'/') for filename in update):oid=tree_hash(relative,update)
  body.append(mode+b' '+name+b'\0'+bytes.fromhex(oid))
 return obj('tree',b''.join(body))

from pathlib import Path
import difflib,hashlib,json,subprocess

out=Path('target/environment-tail-assessment');base='253b32585c96de9f68f399825ca513b50aef7e89'
def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
original=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':docs/tasks/M3.md']);lines=original.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
snapshots={}
for name in ['task-before-parent-routing.md','task-after-parent-routing.md','task-before-child-routing.md','task-after-child-routing.md']:
 data=(out/name).read_bytes();updated=data.decode().splitlines(keepends=True);changes=[]
 for op,a,z,x,y in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None,lines,updated,autojunk=False).get_opcodes():
  if op=='equal':continue
  changes.append(dict(start_line=a,end_line=z,before_sha256=sha(''.join(lines[a:z]).encode()),replacement=''.join(updated[x:y])))
 at=0;rebuilt=[]
 for change in changes:
  a,z=change['start_line'],change['end_line'];assert at<=a<=z<=len(lines)
  rebuilt.extend(lines[at:a]);rebuilt.append(change['replacement']);at=z
 rebuilt.extend(lines[at:]);assert ''.join(rebuilt).encode()==data
 snapshots[name]=dict(sha256=sha(data),bytes=len(data),changes=changes)
records={name:(out/name).read_text() for name in ['parent-record-before-routing.md','parent-record-compact.md','proof-task-before-routing.md','proof-task-compact.md','final-task-before-routing.md','final-task-compact.md']}
payload=dict(schema='archogen-lossless-task-routing-inputs/1',base_commit=base,base_file='docs/tasks/M3.md',base_sha256=sha(original),snapshots=snapshots,records=records,scope='Exact intermediate task states and full/compact records; all project-relative, no unreachable Git object or current task-state dependency')
(out/'routing-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Routing evidence:',len(snapshots),'exact states from retained base;',len(records),'complete records;',len((out/'routing-evidence.json').read_bytes()),'bytes')

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess

out=Path('target/environment-tail-assessment');data=json.loads((out/'routing-evidence.json').read_text())
def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert data['schema']=='archogen-lossless-task-routing-inputs/1'
assert data['base_commit']=='253b32585c96de9f68f399825ca513b50aef7e89' and data['base_file']=='docs/tasks/M3.md'
original=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',data['base_commit']+':'+data['base_file']]);assert sha(original)==data['base_sha256']
lines=original.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
def rebuild(snapshot):
 at=0;chunks=[]
 for change in snapshot['changes']:
  a,z=change['start_line'],change['end_line'];assert type(a) is int and type(z) is int and at<=a<=z<=len(lines)
  assert sha(''.join(lines[a:z]).encode())==change['before_sha256']
  chunks.extend(lines[at:a]);chunks.append(change['replacement']);at=z
 chunks.extend(lines[at:]);raw=''.join(chunks).encode()
 assert len(raw)==snapshot['bytes'] and sha(raw)==snapshot['sha256']
 return raw
expected={'task-before-parent-routing.md','task-after-parent-routing.md','task-before-child-routing.md','task-after-child-routing.md'}
assert set(data['snapshots'])==expected
for name,snapshot in data['snapshots'].items():
 raw=rebuild(snapshot)
 assert Path(name).name==name and not (out/name).is_symlink()
 (out/name).write_bytes(raw)
for name,text in data['records'].items():
 assert Path(name).name==name and name.endswith('.md') and not (out/name).is_symlink()
 (out/name).write_text(text)
false=[]
for name,snapshot in data['snapshots'].items():
 bad=dict(snapshot,sha256='0'*64)
 try:rebuild(bad)
 except AssertionError:false.append(name+':wrong-digest')
 else:raise AssertionError('false routing snapshot accepted')
receipt=dict(status='reconstructed',snapshots=len(expected),records=len(data['records']),negative_controls=false,evidence_sha256=sha((out/'routing-evidence.json').read_bytes()))
(out/'routing-reconstruction.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Routing reconstruction:',len(expected),'exact intermediate states;',len(false),'false snapshot identities refused')

### Environment-loop tail control proof

The exact environment-record tail is redundant. Removing its `continue;` is eligible as a bounded source cleanup, but this proof commit leaves production and all 23 equivalence reasons unchanged. Permanent controls, cleanup with source-guard revalidation, and the final strict current checkpoint are separately owned below. The earlier 1S/full201 measurement remains an initial survivor receipt; this chapter does not rewrite it as an E or claim wider adequacy.

#### Complete local source argument

The [Rust Reference on loops](https://doc.rust-lang.org/reference/expressions/loop-expr.html#continue-expressions) specifies that normal for-body completion and an unlabeled continue return to that loop’s head. The [drop-scope rules](https://doc.rust-lang.org/reference/destructors.html#drop-scopes) order exited nested scopes from inner to outer. This proof reads the pages shipped with pinned1.95.0, identified in the [source ledger](ledger.md#rust-reference); the online links provide navigation and can evolve.

Bind the whole loop from `let mut env_deps = Vec::new();` through its closing brace immediately before the dependency-file loop. Its SHA-256 is `80e6db30d3affc38de38e1a0d3a2f2ab1330cb3caba9f7612809b7735a1f159b`. The actual native edit `L772.stmt.221` comments out just the tail line. The prospective cleanup removes that complete line. Both have the same local effect.

For each possible line, a prefix mismatch executes neither branch in every form. A match executes the same variable split, allowlist check, possible refusal append, normalizer call and environment append, in the same order with the same arguments. There is no reachable statement after the continue within either the if body or for body. Normal fallthrough therefore reaches the same next iterator call. This reasoning applies to arbitrary valid text, scratch strings, canonical scratch strings, crate/producer names and prior refusal contents; the proof does not assume that every record is accepted or that input is nonempty.

At this point `l`, `dep` and `var` are borrowed strings; none has a custom destructor. The returned owned normalized string is already in the outer environment vector. Both paths leave the same branch and iteration scopes before the next iterator call, and leave the outer iterator only at exhaustion. No ownership or borrow crosses a different boundary. Any earlier panic or allocation failure occurs in the identical preceding work; the removed control statement itself performs none of that work. The function has no source-location macro or caller-location dependency on this line. The claim concerns inventory behavior, including ordering/refusals/normalization; it does not assert identical debug metadata, binary bytes or timing.

The loop induction starts with the same empty environment vector and existing refusal vector; the equal per-line transition preserves both through exhaustion. Subsequent dependency collection sees the same values and iterator-independent state. This complete source argument establishes the local no-op result. Finite input agreement and Clippy are supplemental observations.

#### Actual compiler controls and proof boundaries

The actual extracted loop, actual normalizer and actual three-entry catalog allowlist compile under Rust1.95.0, edition2021, at optimization levels0 and3. Seventeen independently written literal cases run in each original/comment/clean form: empty/nonrecord input, accepted and refused variables, namespace lookalikes, first/middle/last records, duplicates, prior refusals, CRLF, Unicode, extra equals, unset records, and raw/canonical/encoded scratch prefixes. The two positive runs contain 102 literal form executions.

A supplemental iterator and line wrapper with real destructors checks a literal sequence of iterator calls and drops in original and clean forms at both optimization levels. These wrappers exercise an even stronger fixture than production’s borrowed-string items; they do not silently change the actual production type claim. An actual compiled added-suffix example distinguishes the forms: the original skips the new observation on environment lines, the cleaned variant performs it. Thus a future reachable suffix invalidates this proof. Four changed source premises are rejected, and four deliberately wrong output/refusal/drop/suffix oracles at each optimization level all fail with exit101 and the intended diagnostic.

Pinned Clippy independently emits two redundant-continue diagnostics, for the original plain collector and destructor fixture. It does not emit that diagnostic for the distinguishing suffix. The extraction also produces14 needless-borrow warnings because probe scratch parameters are already string references; production scratch values are owned strings. This is an observation, not a lint-clean build claim. Preparation’s draft Clippy marker initially omitted the diagnostic’s backticks; reading actual stderr corrected the parser. The draft edit audit initially omitted the native applier’s line join; inspection of the maintained applier corrected it before publication. The actual compiler controls passed throughout.

#### Scope decision and separately committed implementation

The existing text key matches22 physical continue sites and includes a real known other-site kill in the [initial assessment](#environment-loop-tail-initial-assessment). A local proof cannot justify a file-wide reason. The chosen resolution is the separately proved no-op source cleanup, preserving all23 reasons. The final checkpoint must explicitly reconcile this retired physical site, replay every current reason and a distinguishing non-tail continue, revalidate affected source/producer guards and restore the complete original/copied inputs. Absence of a candidate is not the proof. Full compiler/caller/global sweeps, review and later dependency-path work stay open.

pub(crate) const ENV_ALLOWED: [&str; 3] = [
    "CARGO_CRATE_NAME",
    "CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR",
    "CARGO_MANIFEST_PATH",
];
fn normalise_dependency_environment(dep: &str, scratch: &str, canonical_scratch: &str) -> String {
    let encode = |path: &str| {
        path.replace('\\', "\\\\")
            .replace('\n', "\\n")
            .replace('\r', "\\r")
    };
    dep.replace(&encode(scratch), "")
        .replace(&encode(canonical_scratch), "")
}

struct TraceText<'a> { input: &'a str, events: std::rc::Rc<std::cell::RefCell<Vec<&'static str>>> }
struct TraceLines<'a> { lines: std::str::Lines<'a>, events: std::rc::Rc<std::cell::RefCell<Vec<&'static str>>> }
struct TraceLine<'a> { text: &'a str, events: std::rc::Rc<std::cell::RefCell<Vec<&'static str>>> }
impl TraceText<'_> {
    fn lines(&self) -> TraceLines<'_> {
        self.events.borrow_mut().push("lines");
        TraceLines { lines:self.input.lines(), events:self.events.clone() }
    }
}
impl<'a> Iterator for TraceLines<'a> {
    type Item=TraceLine<'a>;
    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
        self.events.borrow_mut().push("next");
        self.lines.next().map(|text| TraceLine { text, events:self.events.clone() })
    }
}
impl std::ops::Deref for TraceLine<'_> { type Target=str; fn deref(&self) -> &str { self.text } }
impl Drop for TraceLine<'_> { fn drop(&mut self) { self.events.borrow_mut().push("drop-line"); } }
impl Drop for TraceLines<'_> { fn drop(&mut self) { self.events.borrow_mut().push("drop-iterator"); } }

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys

out=Path('target/environment-tail-proof');input_root=Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else Path('.')
source=(input_root/'xtask/src/trust.rs').read_text()
def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
assert sha(source.encode())=='9616b59ff2bc394e6471570bfaf857971671fda4a12c4fb745e557d2d21a1751'
start='        let mut env_deps = Vec::new();\n        for l in text.lines() {\n'
end='        for raw in dependency_files(&text, &d, &scratch, &canonical_scratch)? {'
assert source.count(start)==source.count(end)==1
a=source.index(start);z=source.index(end,a);before=source[a:z]
assert sha(before.encode())=='80e6db30d3affc38de38e1a0d3a2f2ab1330cb3caba9f7612809b7735a1f159b'
tail='                continue;\n';assert before.count(tail)==1
commented=before.replace(tail,'                // continue;\n',1)
cleaned=before.replace(tail,'',1)
assert before.endswith(tail+'            }\n        }\n')
normal_start=source.index('fn normalise_dependency_environment(');normal_stop=source.index('\n}',normal_start)+2
normalizer=source[normal_start:normal_stop]
catalog=(input_root/'xtask/src/catalog_build.rs').read_text();c=catalog.index('pub(crate) const ENV_ALLOWED:');d=catalog.index('];',c)+2
allowed=catalog[c:d]
who='producer';crate_name='fixture'
unheld='trust-undeclared-input: `fixture` in `producer` depends on the environment variable `UNHELD`, which the commit does not hold'
empty='trust-undeclared-input: `fixture` in `producer` depends on the environment variable ``, which the commit does not hold'
lookalike='trust-undeclared-input: `fixture` in `producer` depends on the environment variable `CARGO_PKGX_NAME`, which the commit does not hold'
cases=[]
def case(name,text,env,refused,*,prior=None,scratch='__SCRATCH__',canonical='__CANON__'):
 cases.append(dict(name=name,text=text,env=env,refused=refused,prior=[] if prior is None else prior,scratch=scratch,canonical=canonical))
case('empty','',[],[])
case('non-records','plain\n # env-dep:CARGO_PKG_NAME=x\n# Env-dep:CARGO_PKG_NAME=x\n',[],[])
case('one-accepted','# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_NAME=alpha\n',['CARGO_PKG_NAME=alpha'],[])
case('allowed-non-package','# env-dep:CARGO_CRATE_NAME=fixture\n',['CARGO_CRATE_NAME=fixture'],[])
case('foreign','# env-dep:UNHELD=x\n',['UNHELD=x'],[unheld])
case('empty-dependency','# env-dep:\n',[''],[empty])
case('lookalike','# env-dep:CARGO_PKGX_NAME=x\n',['CARGO_PKGX_NAME=x'],[lookalike])
case('first-middle-last','# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_NAME=first\nplain\n# env-dep:UNHELD=x\n# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_NAME=last\n',['CARGO_PKG_NAME=first','UNHELD=x','CARGO_PKG_NAME=last'],[unheld])
case('duplicates','# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_NAME=a\n# env-dep:UNHELD=x\n# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_NAME=a\n# env-dep:UNHELD=x',['CARGO_PKG_NAME=a','UNHELD=x','CARGO_PKG_NAME=a','UNHELD=x'],[unheld,unheld])
case('prior-refusal','# env-dep:UNHELD=x\n',['UNHELD=x'],['prior refusal',unheld],prior=['prior refusal'])
case('crlf','# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_NAME=a\r\nplain\r\n# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_NAME=b\r\n',['CARGO_PKG_NAME=a','CARGO_PKG_NAME=b'],[])
case('unicode','# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_DESCRIPTION=étude💡\n',['CARGO_PKG_DESCRIPTION=étude💡'],[])
case('equals-in-value','# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_DESCRIPTION=a=b=c\n',['CARGO_PKG_DESCRIPTION=a=b=c'],[])
case('unset-record','# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_NAME\n',['CARGO_PKG_NAME'],[])
case('scratch','# env-dep:CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR=__SCRATCH__/crate\n',['CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR=/crate'],[])
case('canonical','# env-dep:CARGO_MANIFEST_PATH=__CANON__/Cargo.toml\n',['CARGO_MANIFEST_PATH=/Cargo.toml'],[])
case('encoded-prefix','# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_DESCRIPTION=work\\\\dir\\nline/x\n',['CARGO_PKG_DESCRIPTION=/x'],[],scratch='work\\dir\nline')
(out/'cases.json').write_text(json.dumps(cases,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')

def string(value):
 return 'String::from_utf8(vec!['+','.join(map(str,value.encode()))+']).unwrap()'
def vector(values):
 return 'vec!['+','.join(string(v) for v in values)+']' if values else 'Vec::<String>::new()'
def collect(name,body,*,trace=False,suffix=False):
 header='#[inline(never)]\nfn '+name+'(input: &str, scratch: &str, canonical_scratch: &str, who: &str, crate_name: &str, refused: &mut Vec<String>)'
 if trace:
  header+=' -> (Vec<String>, Vec<&\'static str>) {\n    let events=std::rc::Rc::new(std::cell::RefCell::new(Vec::new()));\n    let text=TraceText { input, events:events.clone() };\n'
 else:header+=' -> '+('(Vec<String>, Vec<String>)' if suffix else 'Vec<String>')+' {\n    let text=input;\n'
 if suffix:
  needle='            }\n        }\n';assert body.count(needle)==1
  body=body.replace(needle,'            }\n            suffix.push(l.to_owned());\n        }\n',1)
  header+='    let mut suffix=Vec::new();\n'
 ending='    let snapshot=events.borrow().clone();\n    (env_deps, snapshot)\n' if trace else ('    (env_deps, suffix)\n' if suffix else '    env_deps\n')
 return header+body+ending+'}\n'

trace_source='''
struct TraceText<'a> { input: &'a str, events: std::rc::Rc<std::cell::RefCell<Vec<&'static str>>> }
struct TraceLines<'a> { lines: std::str::Lines<'a>, events: std::rc::Rc<std::cell::RefCell<Vec<&'static str>>> }
struct TraceLine<'a> { text: &'a str, events: std::rc::Rc<std::cell::RefCell<Vec<&'static str>>> }
impl TraceText<'_> {
    fn lines(&self) -> TraceLines<'_> {
        self.events.borrow_mut().push("lines");
        TraceLines { lines:self.input.lines(), events:self.events.clone() }
    }
}
impl<'a> Iterator for TraceLines<'a> {
    type Item=TraceLine<'a>;
    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
        self.events.borrow_mut().push("next");
        self.lines.next().map(|text| TraceLine { text, events:self.events.clone() })
    }
}
impl std::ops::Deref for TraceLine<'_> { type Target=str; fn deref(&self) -> &str { self.text } }
impl Drop for TraceLine<'_> { fn drop(&mut self) { self.events.borrow_mut().push("drop-line"); } }
impl Drop for TraceLines<'_> { fn drop(&mut self) { self.events.borrow_mut().push("drop-iterator"); } }
'''
program=allowed+'\n'+normalizer+'\n'+trace_source
for name,body in [('collect_before',before),('collect_comment',commented),('collect_clean',cleaned)]:program+=collect(name,body)
for name,body in [('drop_before',before),('drop_clean',cleaned)]:program+=collect(name,body,trace=True)
for name,body in [('suffix_before',before),('suffix_clean',cleaned)]:program+=collect(name,body,suffix=True)
checks=[]
for row in cases:
 for name in ['collect_before','collect_comment','collect_clean']:
  checks.append('    { let mut refused='+vector(row['prior'])+'; let have='+name+'(&'+string(row['text'])+', &'+string(row['scratch'])+', &'+string(row['canonical'])+', "producer", "fixture", &mut refused);\n'
   +'      assert_eq!(have, '+vector(row['env'])+', "env:'+row['name']+':'+name+'"); assert_eq!(refused, '+vector(row['refused'])+', "refusal:'+row['name']+':'+name+'"); }\n')
drop_input='# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_NAME=a\nplain\n# env-dep:UNHELD=x\n'
drop_expected=['lines','next','drop-line','next','drop-line','next','drop-line','next','drop-iterator']
for name in ['drop_before','drop_clean']:
 checks.append('    { let mut refused=Vec::new(); let (env,events)='+name+'(&'+string(drop_input)+', "__SCRATCH__", "__CANON__", "producer", "fixture", &mut refused);\n'
  +'      assert_eq!(env, '+vector(['CARGO_PKG_NAME=a','UNHELD=x'])+'); assert_eq!(refused, '+vector([unheld])+');\n'
  +'      assert_eq!(events, vec!['+','.join(json.dumps(e) for e in drop_expected)+'], "literal drop/next order:'+name+'"); }\n')
suffix_input='# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_NAME=a\nplain\n'
checks.append('    let mut left_refused=Vec::new(); let mut right_refused=Vec::new();\n'
 '    let left=suffix_before(&'+string(suffix_input)+', "S", "C", "producer", "fixture", &mut left_refused);\n'
 '    let right=suffix_clean(&'+string(suffix_input)+', "S", "C", "producer", "fixture", &mut right_refused);\n'
 '    assert_eq!(left.1, '+vector(['plain'])+'); assert_eq!(right.1, '+vector(['# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_NAME=a','plain'])+'); assert_ne!(left.1,right.1,"reachable suffix is distinguishing");\n')
checks.append('    match std::env::args().nth(1).as_deref() {\n'
 '      Some("wrong-env") => { let mut refused=Vec::new(); assert_eq!(collect_clean("# env-dep:CARGO_PKG_NAME=alpha", "S", "C", "producer", "fixture", &mut refused), '+vector(['WRONG'])+', "wrong env literal"); },\n'
 '      Some("wrong-refusal") => { let mut refused=Vec::new(); collect_clean("# env-dep:UNHELD=x", "S", "C", "producer", "fixture", &mut refused); assert!(refused.is_empty(),"wrong refusal literal"); },\n'
 '      Some("wrong-suffix-equality") => assert_eq!(left.1,right.1,"wrong suffix equality"),\n'
 '      Some("wrong-drop-order") => { let mut refused=Vec::new(); let (_,events)=drop_clean("plain", "S", "C", "producer", "fixture", &mut refused); assert_eq!(events,vec!["drop-iterator","next"],"wrong drop order"); },\n'
 '      _ => {}\n    }\n')
program+='fn main() {\n'+''.join(checks)+'    println!("tail-proof: passed '+str(len(cases))+' literal cases in3 forms; drop and distinguishing-suffix controls");\n}\n'
(out/'probe.rs').write_text(program)
after_source=source[:a]+cleaned+source[z:]
assert after_source.count('                continue;\n')==source.count('                continue;\n')-1
receipt=dict(status='prepared',scope='Actual current loop and normalizer/allowlist; actual comment edit and candidate cleanup; independent literal/drop/suffix controls only, not equivalence from finite agreement.',source_sha256=sha(source.encode()),before_loop_sha256=sha(before.encode()),comment_loop_sha256=sha(commented.encode()),clean_loop_sha256=sha(cleaned.encode()),prospective_source_sha256=sha(after_source.encode()),prospective_production_sha256=sha(after_source.split('#[cfg(test)]',1)[0].encode()),cases=len(cases),collector_forms=['collect_before','collect_comment','collect_clean'],drop_forms=['drop_before','drop_clean'],wrong_oracles=['wrong-env','wrong-refusal','wrong-suffix-equality','wrong-drop-order'],source_function='normalise_dependency_environment',source_allowlist='catalog_build::ENV_ALLOWED',probe_sha256=sha(program.encode()))
(out/'probe-preparation.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
for name,data in [('loop-before.rs.txt',before),('loop-comment.rs.txt',commented),('loop-clean.rs.txt',cleaned),('prospective-source.rs.txt',after_source)]:

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess

root=Path.cwd();out=Path('target/environment-tail-proof')
def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
profile=out/'volume.sb'
profile.write_text('(version 1)\n(allow default)\n(deny file-write*)\n(allow file-write* (subpath (param "WRITABLE_ROOT")))\n(allow file-write-data (literal "/dev/null"))\n')
rows=[]
def run(label,command,expected=0,marker=None):
    actual=['/usr/bin/sandbox-exec','-D','WRITABLE_ROOT='+str(root),'-f',str(profile),*command]
    p=subprocess.run(actual,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env=dict(os.environ),timeout=120)
    (out/(label+'.stdout')).write_bytes(p.stdout);(out/(label+'.stderr')).write_bytes(p.stderr)
    row=dict(label=label,command=command,exit=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout.decode(),stderr=p.stderr.decode())
    rows.append(row)
    assert p.returncode==expected,(label,row)
    if marker:assert marker in row['stdout']+row['stderr'],(label,marker,row)
    return row
run('rustc-version',['rustc','--version','--verbose'])
run('clippy-version',['clippy-driver','--version'])
for opt in ['0','3']:
    binary=str(out/('probe-O'+opt))
    run('compile-O'+opt,['rustc','--edition=2021','-C','opt-level='+opt,str(out/'probe.rs'),'-o',binary])
    run('positive-O'+opt,[binary],marker='passed 17 literal cases')
    for arm,marker in [('wrong-env','wrong env literal'),('wrong-refusal','wrong refusal literal'),('wrong-suffix-equality','wrong suffix equality'),('wrong-drop-order','wrong drop order')]:
        run(arm+'-O'+opt,[binary,arm],101,marker)
run('clippy-observation',['clippy-driver','--edition=2021','--emit=metadata','-W','clippy::needless_continue',str(out/'probe.rs'),'-o',str(out/'clippy.rmeta')])
assert sha(Path('xtask/src/trust.rs').read_bytes())=='9616b59ff2bc394e6471570bfaf857971671fda4a12c4fb745e557d2d21a1751'
receipt=dict(status='passed',scope='Pinned actual compiler observations support the complete source argument; finite cases alone are not equivalence proof.',profile_sha256=sha(profile.read_bytes()),probe_sha256=sha((out/'probe.rs').read_bytes()),runs=rows,optimizations=['0','3'],literal_cases_per_form=17,forms=3,drop_forms=2,wrong_oracle_executions=8,clippy_needless_continue_observed='this '+chr(96)+'continue'+chr(96)+' expression is redundant' in rows[-1]['stderr'])
(out/'probe-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in receipt.items() if k!='runs'}))

### Permanent environment-tail controls

The [complete local source proof](#environment-loop-tail-control-proof) now has a maintained control in `EnvironmentTailTests.test_environment_tail_fallthrough_requires_the_complete_terminal_scope` in `xtask/mutation_sweep_tests.py`. It runs outside the 201-test semantic parent population. Production source and all23 reason records remain byte-identical. The separately owned no-op cleanup and full current native checkpoint follow this commit.

The guard accepts only the exact original-terminal and cleaned-fallthrough loop shapes, reconstructing the historical preimage after cleanup. It binds the complete terminal scope, borrowed-string origin, actual normalizer and actual catalog allowlist. Seven changed premises are deliberately refused: a reachable suffix, labeled target, iterator change, record prefix, normalizer change, different text source type and changed allowlist. A future change requires the source argument to be revalidated; it cannot silently inherit a broader equivalence.

Actual Rust1.95.0 at optimization0 and3 compiles all three original/comment/clean forms. Each runs17 independent literal environment/refusal cases, including record positions, duplicates, prior refusal state, Unicode/CRLF and encoded scratch paths. Supplemental real destructors hold exact iteration/drop order, and an added suffix distinguishes the forms. All four deliberately wrong output/refusal/drop/suffix oracles fail at both optimization levels. These observations support the source proof; finite agreement alone is not the proof.

The full operator suite passes50 tests in the captured actual execution. Removing only the new class reconstructs the previous file byte for byte: all49 older operator controls are retained. The suite’s source identities restore exactly. No Rust semantic parent was added and no mutation outcome is classified by this leaf.

The initial supplemental drop fixture used canonical prefix `C` while expecting `CARGO_PKG_NAME=a` unchanged. The real normalizer correctly produced `ARGO_PKG_NAME=a`, so its literal assertion failed. This test-fixture defect is fixed with the non-overlapping `__SCRATCH__`/`__CANON__` prefixes used in the independent cases. It is owned and closed by this leaf, with the full50-test run on the corrected maintained source. Production normalization was correct and unchanged.

Run the maintained control or full operator suite from the repository root with its local stores prepared:

python3 -I -B xtask/mutation_sweep_tests.py "$PWD"
```

All329 earlier task archives remain at their retained commit’s exact blob identities. The committed proof leaf is sealed as the330th archive, reconstructing its old task span exactly. Three task states reconstruct from the retained input commit and small line deltas; three wrong snapshot identities and a truncated seal are refused. The book retains every previous byte and the complete evidence/adapter source below.
